items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: there's a fella called Sandsbury, was running it while we left there.

ctx.x: And you had one of those overhead then?

I had it then. You see, I used to use it in the studio. And when I come back, there's a fella called Sandsbury, was running it while we left there. And when I come back and look for the overhead trap, I don't know if one of the guys got it out there or what. But I asked Tubby Hall, you might remember? I knew Tubby, yeah. I knew Tubby Hall, and the zoo that used to be down at the place often because we used to have our little portals down here. So I asked Tubby, I said, Tubby, I said, you ever seen my overhead…
